summary: Sign in with email and password
description:
As an advisor, I want to sign in with my email and password so that only I can see my clients' portfolio.
Acceptance criteria:
- Given the demo account, when I submit the correct email and password, then I land on the portfolio page and see "Welcome back, <name>"
- Given a wrong password, when I submit, then I see "Email or password is incorrect." and stay on the login page
- Given an empty form, when I submit, then I see "Enter your email and password."
